## What changed
Docs only. No app code, content, migrations or config.
- `docs/content-status/practice-availability-2026-11.md` — the 6 Nov audit, committed unchanged.
- `docs/plans/student-journey-trace-2026-11.md` — B1–B10 verdicts with file:line evidence, re-run totals, new decisions D11–D13, stop-rule status.

## Evidence
- Base: `origin/dev` @ 17d8be2f.
- Totals re-run through `getExamBank("practice")` (script not committed): 1,601 served (Y3 940 / Y5 661), 141 strand groups, 95 with 5+, 81 strand labels, 17 duplicate-prompt groups / 68 questions. **Zero delta from the audit.**

## Headline findings
- **B1:** practice sets cannot resume (client-only, drawn from the key-bearing guest bank). Stop rule fires: no practice-set Continue, no backend.
- **B3:** an eligibility cell is only `{count, fullDurationSeconds}`; an empty cell reads 600s, and an integrity failure is indistinguishable from "none". "Couldn't check" needs a separate publication-eligibility read.
- **B5:** the Singapore sample proves the store and response shape, not general marking. Real P6 cost: server-selected answer-stripped delivery, and storage (a dedicated table would need a migration).
- **B7:** no lesson progress is stored; `discovery-recommendations.ts` hardcodes 0.
- **B9:** no help articles or report records exist. **B10:** per-student settings exist on `profiles`, but a new preference needs a migration.

## Tests
Docs only; typecheck, lint, test, build, validate:questions, check:answers, questions:validate-ledger, test:rls, test:e2e, test:e2e:auth were **not run** locally. CI will run on the PR.

## UNVERIFIED
Response retention after submit (P10), server scoring of matching/ordering/multi-select (P6/P7), Year 5 lesson coverage (P5), mixed-mark or writing sources in exam patterns (P8).

## Follow-ups
Decisions D1, D10–D13 needed from the owner before the phases they block.
